The orange rainfall warning was raised in Zambales, Pampanga, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Rizal, and Bulacan (Angat, Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bustos, Calumpit, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Guiguinto, Norzagaray, Pandi, Plaridel, Pulilan, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, San Rafael, Santa Maria).

Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, which may persist within three hours, according to PAGASA.

data.text:
TORRENTIAL RAINS PROMPT RED RAINFALL WARNING IN METRO MANILA, NEARBY PROVINCES

PAGASA has issued a Red Rainfall Warning over Metro Manila, Bataan and parts of Bulacan as of 8 p.m. Monday due to the enhanced southwest monsoon or habagat.

The red warning—PAGASA’s highest alert level for rainfall—means serious flooding is expected, especially in low-lying and flood-prone areas.

An Orange Warning is raised over Zambales, Pampanga, Cavite, Batangas, Laguna, Rizal and other parts of Bulacan, where intense rainfall may still lead to flooding and possible landslides.

Yellow Warning is in effect in Tarlac and Quezon, while light to moderate rains with occasional heavy downpours are affecting Nueva Ecija.
